parsed.rationale: The cluster surfaces two near-duplicate HEIF-encoding routines — `encodeCGImageAsHEIF` in package `Artwork` (CachingArtworkFetcher.swift:75) and `Image.heifData` in package `Core` (ImageCompatability.swift:107) — with a Jaccard similarity of 0.706, indicating substantial shared logic. `Core` is the natural canonical home because it already owns the image-compatibility surface (`ImageCompatability.swift`) and `Artwork` is a consumer package that depends on `Core`. Consolidating into `Core` eliminates the duplicate, keeps the implementation in the upstream package, and lets `CachingArtworkFetcher` call `Core`'s `Image.heifData` directly. Neither record carries any restraint marker (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), so no intentional-duplication rule applies.
